corrections.why: None of the three pages gives a height for this ground-level site; 213.4 m (about 700 ft) is not supported by any source read

resolved_conflicts.explanation: Firelookout.com lists a cabin in 1929; firetower.org gives 1945 as the build year, and the 1945 newspaper accounts call the post the first lookout on the crest. Recorded as 1945.
Both site listings place the site in the Winema National Forest; 1945 newspaper reports name the Rogue River National Forest district. Both are noted in the story.
The site record gives 7,311 ft; a 1945 Herald and News item gives 6,700 ft. The story gives the record figure and notes the newspaper figure.

notes_for_editor: The 1945 detail comes from Weebly transcriptions of Herald and News, Medford Mail Tribune and Grants Pass Courier clippings; the originals were not opened. The brief's height_m (213.4) has no support and is flagged for removal. Forest attribution differs between the site listings (Winema) and the 1945 press (Rogue River). The 1929 cabin claim on firelookout.com conflicts with the 1945 first-on-crest accounts. No photos, later staffing or access information were found.
